description: This Java interface defines a repository for Email entities, providing methods for querying emails across different mailbox folders and performing full-text search within the email content. It extends JpaRepository, indicating it is part of a Spring Data JPA setup.

classes.name: EmailRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for Email entities, providing methods for mailbox folder queries and full-text search.

methods.name: findByOwnerAndFolderAndIsDeletedFalseAndIsArchivedFalseOrderByReceivedAtDescCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Retrieves emails in the inbox folder that are not deleted or archived, ordered by received date and creation date descending.

methods.name: findByOwnerAndFolderAndIsDeletedFalseOrderBySentAtDescCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Retrieves sent emails that are not deleted, ordered by sent date and creation date descending.

methods.name: findByOwnerAndFolderAndIsDeletedFalseOrderByUpdatedAtDescCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Retrieves draft emails that are not deleted, ordered by last updated date and creation date descending.

methods.name: findByOwnerAndIsDeletedTrueOrderByUpdatedAtDescCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Retrieves emails marked as deleted (trash), ordered by last updated date and creation date descending.

methods.name: findByOwnerAndIsArchivedTrueOrderByUpdatedAtDescCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Retrieves archived emails, ordered by last updated date and creation date descending.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a full-text search across subject and body fields of emails for a specific owner, excluding deleted emails, ordered by update and creation dates.

calls: select e from Email e where e.owner = :owner and e.isDeleted = false and (lower(coalesce(e.subject,'')) like lower(concat('%', :q, '%')) or lower(coalesce(e.bodyText,'')) like lower(concat('%', :q, '%')) or lower(coalesce(e.bodyHtml,'')) like lower(concat('%', :q, '%')) or lower(coalesce(e.fromAddr,'')) like lower(concat('%', :q, '%')) or lower(coalesce(e.toAddrs,'')) like lower(concat('%', :q, '%')))
